name: Vector R

origin.basis: Goodyear's bicycle-tire line was developed with Rubber Kinetics by a team at Goodyear's Akron, Ohio headquarters (Bicycle Retailer, 2018).

manufacturing.basis: Goodyear does not state where these tires are made.

positioning: Wider tubeless-ready road and all-road tire in 30, 35 and 40 mm.

sizes.note: Z30 NSW, 150 TPI; a sidewall-protected Z30 SW is 325 g

weight_basis: Goodyear store weights for this construction.

availability.note: Sold by Goodyear Bicycle Tires' US-dollar web store; mainland China and European availability not verified for this model.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; US shipping and tax at checkout.

caveats: Two 30 mm versions are listed (with or without sidewall protection); the store variant does not say which ships.

image.shown: Goodyear's cutaway render of the tubeless Vector R; one render covers every width.
image.alt: Goodyear Vector R tubeless road tire render with a cutaway showing the casing

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out.

checks.note: Only the Zipp-specific Vector R Z30 and Vector R XPLR are listed
